proposals.evidence: Turner’s aṅgūḍi branch explicitly lists Maiya agui/aṅgui and Shina Kohistani haṅui, beside Jijel háguṛi. Chiliss hāgvī fits this northern h-initial contracted series with the vowel/glide written v; it is kept separate from the first aṅguli branch used for the southern survey forms.
